description: Ministry of Public Services Provincial Councils ad Local Government - Amendment to the Minutes on Pension (Staff of State Ministers)
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the Schedule "Q" of the Minutes on Pensions to include specific staff positions (Coordinating Secretary/Public Relation Officer/Media Secretary) for State Ministers. The content deals with public service pension benefits and service conditions, which falls under the Public Service category (Type 8) for public sector service conditions and benefits, rather than being a government personnel change or structural reorganization.
